title: QuadrantTaskBoard
description: A task board on a four-quadrant matrix, such as an Eisenhower matrix: the + of a quadrant header (or a click on its empty area) adds a task, compact edit and delete buttons on the active task (in its card, beside its name, on React) edit or delete it, a panel opened right at the + button or at the task names it and picks its quadrant, an inline confirmation guards every delete, and tasks move by drag and drop or Shift + arrow keys (a double click edits them). The board is controlled: pass the tasks as points and set back the list received by onPointsChange. It accepts the other props of QuadrantChart (axes, quadrant titles, badges and colors, ticks, labels…) and its buttons and panels follow the language of the app. Exported by minerva-design, not minerva-design/charts.

wc:minerva-quadrant-task-board.summary: Four-quadrant task board: add, edit, delete and drag tasks between quadrants.
wc:minerva-quadrant-task-board.description: Task board on a four-quadrant matrix (`<QuadrantTaskBoard>` of React), built on `<minerva-quadrant-chart>`: each quadrant header shows its title, the number of tasks and an add button; the point card of the active task (hovered, keyboard-focused or selected) shows edit and delete buttons beside its name; an inline panel, anchored inside the board at the button or the task, names a task and picks its quadrant, or confirms a delete (Escape or a press outside closes it). Tasks can be dragged to another quadrant, or moved with Shift + arrows once focused; a double click edits a task, a click on an empty area adds one there. Controlled, like `<minerva-dashboard-columns>`: the board never changes its own `points`. It fires `minerva-points-change` with the next list after an add, an edit, a delete, a drag and drop or a keyboard move; set it back as `points` to apply it (or keep the old list to refuse it). Texts are localized (the `locale` attribute, else the library language) and can be overridden with `labels`. The host's `aria-label` names the chart. Published as the optional entry `minerva-design/web-components/quadrant-task-board` (it loads the chart engine, minerva-design/charts/core).

basic.title: Eisenhower board
basic.description: Urgent tasks on the left (reverseX) and important ones at the top: click + or the empty area of a quadrant to add a task, select a task to edit or delete it, and drag it (or press Shift + an arrow key) to move it to another quadrant. The sample names follow the page language until you rename them.

custom-labels.title: Custom texts and badges
custom-labels.description: A product roadmap by effort and impact: labels renames the buttons, the name field and the delete confirmation ({name} stands for the item), quadrants gives each header a numbered badge, and every change from onPointsChange is counted.

QuadrantTaskBoardProps.onPointsChange: Called with the next list of tasks after an add, an edit, a delete, a drag and drop or a keyboard move (controlled: pass it back as points)
QuadrantTaskBoardProps.labels: Texts of the buttons and panels (see QuadrantTaskLabels); the ones left out follow the locale

QuadrantTaskLabels.add: Add button of each quadrant, and title of the add panel
QuadrantTaskLabels.edit: Edit button of the active task, and title of the edit panel
QuadrantTaskLabels.delete: Delete button of the active task, and title of its confirmation
QuadrantTaskLabels.deleteConfirm: Text of the delete confirmation; {name} is replaced by the name of the task
QuadrantTaskLabels.confirmDelete: Confirm button of the delete confirmation
QuadrantTaskLabels.name: Label of the name field
QuadrantTaskLabels.save: Save button of the add / edit panel
QuadrantTaskLabels.actions: Accessible name of the toolbar of the active task

QuadrantConfig.points: Tasks { x, y, label, color, size }: the controlled list, updated through onPointsChange
QuadrantConfig.xSplit: X value of the vertical divider (middle of xDomain by default)
QuadrantConfig.ySplit: Y value of the horizontal divider (middle of yDomain by default)
QuadrantConfig.quadrants: Titles, badges and colors of the quadrants; a quadrant without a title shows a localized default one
QuadrantConfig.axisLabels: Texts at the ends of the dividers, drawn inside the plot (e.g. "Important" at the top)
QuadrantConfig.showTicks: Shows the numeric ticks of the axes; false keeps only the matrix
QuadrantConfig.reverseX: Reverses the horizontal axis (e.g. urgent on the left)
QuadrantConfig.showLabels: Draws the task names next to the dots, skipping overlaps
QuadrantConfig.name: Name of the tasks in the tooltip
QuadrantConfig.draggable: Lets the user drag the tasks to another quadrant (on by default on the board; false turns it off)
QuadrantConfig.showCounts: Shows the number of tasks after each quadrant title (on by default on the board; false hides it, a function (count, points) returns the text instead)
QuadrantConfig.selectedIndex: Index of the selected task, drawn with a ring (null: none); by default the board selects the last clicked, moved or saved task
QuadrantConfig.selectedIndices: Indices of several selected tasks, each drawn with a ring

native_QuadrantTaskBoardProps.onPointsChange: Called with the next list of tasks after an add, an edit, a delete, a drag and drop or a “Move to” accessibility action (controlled: pass it back as points)
native_QuadrantTaskBoardProps.labels: Texts of the buttons and panels (add, edit, delete, deleteConfirm, confirmDelete, name, quadrant, save, cancel, actions); the ones left out follow the locale

cssVars.--quadrant-task-board-header-color: Text color of the quadrant titles (defaults to --text-color)
cssVars.--quadrant-task-board-header-background: Background of the quadrant headers (defaults to a translucent surface)
cssVars.--quadrant-task-board-count-background: Background of the task count chips (defaults to --surface-muted-color)
cssVars.--quadrant-task-board-count-color: Text color of the task count chips (defaults to --text-secondary-color)
cssVars.--quadrant-task-board-actions-background: Background of the toolbar of the active task (defaults to --surface-elevated-color)
cssVars.--quadrant-task-board-actions-radius: Corner radius of the toolbar of the active task (defaults to --radius-md)
cssVars.--quadrant-task-board-panel-background: Background of the inline add / edit / delete panel (defaults to a translucent elevated surface)
cssVars.--quadrant-task-board-panel-border: Border color of the inline panel (defaults to a translucent --border-color)
cssVars.--quadrant-task-board-panel-radius: Corner radius of the inline panel (defaults to --radius-lg)
cssVars.--quadrant-task-board-panel-width: Width of the inline panel (defaults to 288px)

native.limitations: On React Native, tasks move by drag and drop or with the “Move to” actions of screen readers: there are no Shift + arrow key moves and no double tap to edit (use the edit button of the active task). The icons of the buttons are drawn with Views, without an SVG dependency.
